card.text: Explore Setebos, a moon of Uranus, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Setebos is an outer moon of Uranus. This model translates observed brightness variation into a minimum elongation, assuming uniform reflectivity, equal short axes and a doubled shape-driven rotation period. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid from brightness variability, using an assumed-albedo 47 km size. Equal short axes and orientation are assumed; the rotation period adopts a doubled shape interpretation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
